EnableLQM.Description: Enable ZH's Artisan Goods style for Large Quail Mayonnaise

LQMTexture.Description: Select the texture for ZH's Large Quail Mayonnaise from standard size or larger size

LQMLabel.Description: Select if you want a label on Large Quail Mayonnaise

EnableLQMCover.Description: Enable fabric cover over the lid. This only appears on the Standard size Large Quail Mayonnaise

LQMCoverColour.AllowValues: Brown, Cool_White, Navy, Off_White, Orange, Vanilla, Warm_White
LQMCoverColour.Description: Select the fabric colour for Large Quail Mayonnaise (Will only appear if Fabric Cover is enabled)

LQMCopyQuality.Description: If enabled, the Large Quail Mayonnaise will stay the same quality as the Large Quail Egg used to create it
